messages:
SRE-Bot: ALERT: Elevated p99 latency on inference streaming in prod-eu. Trigger: p99 > 750ms over 3m. Affected paths: inference->auth->config-service->user-db. Paging @Sanjay and @Elaine. Severity: Sev2 (customer impact risk).

Sanjay: Im on it. pulling traces + starting flame graphs. initiating paging loop.

Elaine: looking at auth-service metrics. token-cache miss rate spiked to 40% at 11:52 UTC. seeing many backend 502/504s from config-service calls.

Sanjay: streaming metrics: p95 ~95ms stable, p99 jumped to 860ms at 11:51. streaming error rate up ~1.1%. route-level heatmap: eur-west-1 heavy. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/prod/inference/streams?panel=latency

OpsBot: Created bridge: https://meet.redwood/incident-2167770001 (auto-join enabled).

Maria: infra check: DB read queue depth for user-db spiked; one replica showing IO saturation. I can move read traffic off the hot replica and promote another replica for reads.

Sanjay: do that. Also Elaine, can you validate whether feature-flag evaluations call out to config-service synchronously per request? If so, we need a quick cache override.

Elaine: confirmed: control-plane feature flag client does per-request fetch for some keys in the hot path (old client code). I'm pushing a runtime flag to enable in-memory LRU caching for 60s as emergency override.

Szymon: logging note: we should enable short-circuit for config-service for the next 10 minutes to prevent cascades. I'll add a circuit-breaker rule after we stabilize.

Maria: rerouted reads, decreasing load on the saturated replica. command: aws rds modify-db-instance --db-instance-identifier user-db-replica-3 --apply-immediately --upgraded-iops. observed replication lag ~<50ms. p99 db-read decreased 700ms -> 130ms within 70s.

Elaine: toggled control-plane cache override: `featureflag.cache_ttl_override=60s` via console for prod-eu. token-cache miss rate dropping; auth 429s falling.

Sanjay: runtime mitigation: applying a temporary routing policy to route long-poll streaming sessions to low-latency backends and enable smaller model-variant fallback for requests that cross 500ms threshold. Applying canary 15% now.

OpsBot: Automated note: support notified group: #support-status updated.

Lia: Customer Ops: ACME and Finlytics reported reconnects. I've sent an interim status message: "Were aware of intermittent streaming reconnects and applying mitigations; limited customers affected; follow-up with RCA and timeline."

Elaine: auth-service metrics: token verification fallback (cache-only mode) reduced upstream calls by ~78%. streaming errors trending down.

Sanjay: good. capture telemetry: we need traces for a sample of failed streams and successful fast-fallbacks. I'll collect 50 traces and attach to the ticket.

Szymon: suggested post-incident actions: batch feature-flag lookups, add client-side caching in control-plane SDKs, and add a per-route config TTL override feature in console.

Maria: leaving one extra read-replica active for 15 minutes while we monitor. currently p99 is stable around 110ms.

Sanjay: estimated impact: ~0.9% of streaming sessions had transient stalls between 11:48-12:02 UTC. Retry succeeded in most cases; we saw no persisted state corruption. Customers impacted: ACME (3 sessions), Finlytics (2 sessions), some internal QA tenants. Logging shows reconnects but no token revocations.

Elaine: rolling a small hotfix to control-plane client to avoid per-request blocking calls for flags. will merge after quick code review and deploy to prod-eu canary.

OpsBot: Reminder: Handoff to night oncall (Noah) in 25m. Please leave summary + actions.

Sanjay: Handoff summary for Noah:
- Probable root cause: control-plane feature-flag client made synchronous per-request configfetches, creating read amplification on user-db and config-service -> token-cache misses -> auth and streaming p99 spikes.
- Immediate mitigations: DB read reroute (Maria), control-plane cache-override (Elaine), token-cache fallback (Elaine), routing canary to small model variant (Sanjay).
- Current status: Mitigated. p99 back to baseline. Customer impact limited to transient reconnects.
- Action items for follow-up: create a postmortem, implement batching for feature-flag queries, add circuit-breaker for config-service, expose quick TTL override on console, add token-cache warmers, and run load test for control-plane.

Noah: ack. I'll pick this up and own the postmortem. pls tag me on the ticket.

Sanjay: opening ticket PM-TKT-2026-03-216777. attaching traces + timeline + graphs.

Maria: note for postmortem: replica IO spike traced to a thundering read pattern from seq id range queries in control-plane during a traffic blip at 11:48. we'll include query profiles.

Elaine: will add a runbook entry for toggling `auth.token.cache_mode=cache_only` in high-backpressure events and add a one-click console control.

Lia: updated customers with a follow-up ETA for RCA by EOD tomorrow.

Sanjay: closing incident channel in 15m if stable. thanks everyone. great coordination. :white_check_mark: 

OpsBot: Incident STATUS -> Mitigated. Postmortem due EOD tomorrow.
